description: This Java class defines an immutable, sharable map from resource types (strings) to Akka ActorRef references, used for managing entity region mappings in a distributed system.

classes.name: EntityRegionMap
classes.description: Immutable class mapping resource types to actor references with lookup and builder capabilities.

classes.name: EntityRegionMap.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing EntityRegionMap instances.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Retrieve the actor reference for a given resource type, wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: findRegion
methods.description: Internal method to find the actor reference for a resource type, returning null if not found.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Implementation of Function interface to retrieve ActorRef for a resource type, nullable.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Create an EntityRegionMap with a single resource type-to-ActorRef mapping.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Create a new builder for EntityRegionMap.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Equality check based on rawMap field.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generate hash code based on rawMap.

methods.description: Return string representation of the EntityRegionMap.
